deviation: The draft sets the minimum cover at USD 500,000 per claim, a tenth of the USD 5M standard and below the USD 2M fallback. It also doesn't name the insurance types (professional indemnity and commercial general liability), so Arcadia could be left with inadequate or wrongly scoped cover for losses the Supplier can't pay itself. The certificate-on-request wording is acceptable.
suggested_text: 14.1 The Supplier shall maintain throughout the term, with a reputable insurer, professional indemnity and commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000 per claim. The Supplier shall provide certificates of insurance on request.
